Geometry Game usually refers to Geometry Dash, a popular rhythm-based action platformer by RobTop Games. In the game, a geometric shape moves forward automatically while you press space, click, or tap to jump and dodge spikes or hazards synced to electronic music.

Core Gameplay
Automatic Movement: Your icon slides or flies forward on its own, so you only control timing. 
Music Sync: Jumps, gravity flips, and vehicle changes line up directly with the background track. 
Instant Resets: Crashing into a wall or spike sends you straight back to the start of the level. 
Practice Mode: Allows you to place custom checkpoints to master difficult sections.
